title: Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents
summary: Vercel released durable-harness, an open-source package that logs every model and tool call so Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex sessions resume after crashes, timeouts and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres or a laptop. The post Vercel Open-Sources durable-harness for Crash-Proof Coding Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
